description: This PHP class 'GroupedTabStructure' provides methods to generate and manage a structure of UI tabs for the SuiteCRM application. It handles tab configurations, merging patches, and filtering modules for display in a tabbed interface.

classes.name: GroupedTabStructure
classes.description: A class responsible for managing the tab structure in the SuiteCRM user interface, including retrieving and merging module lists and configurations.

methods.name: get_tab_structure
methods.description: Generates the complete tab-group structure, optionally merging patches, including or excluding modules and iframe tabs, and returning the structure with labels as keys or as numeric indices.
